interaction_paths.auth: HttpOnly session cookie plus subscription authorization
OIDC BFF session plus run:cancel policy

external_channels.name: Run event stream
external_channels.auth: Same-origin HttpOnly session cookie, Origin check, per-run authorization

server_buffer.overflow_policy: coalesce deltas, then disconnect slow client for snapshot resync

client_buffer.overflow_policy: coalesce render updates and request snapshot resync

external_channels.name: Run command API
external_channels.auth: OIDC BFF session plus run:create policy

reliability.idempotency: Idempotency-Key scoped to user and endpoint
reliability.retry: Only retry idempotent requests with bounded backoff and jitter

internal_channels.name: Agent lifecycle and result events
internal_channels.auth: mTLS workload identity plus topic ACL

reliability.idempotency: inbox table keyed by event_id; business idempotency key for side effects
reliability.retention: 30 days for facts; token deltas are coalesced and only checkpoints are durable

contracts.compatibility: Additive optional fields are backward compatible; removals require a major version

security.user_authentication: OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE through a BFF and HttpOnly Secure SameSite session cookie
security.service_authentication: mTLS workload identity with audience-scoped short-lived credentials
security.token_lifecycle: Short-lived access tokens; close or re-authenticate long-lived streams at expiry
security.stream_authentication: Cookie session or single-use short-lived ticket; authorize each run subscription
security.origin_policy: Explicit HTTPS origin allowlist; credentialed CORS never uses wildcard
security.webhook: Timestamped HMAC verification with replay window and idempotency
security.secrets: Managed secret store with rotation, overlap windows, and audit
security.audit: Log authentication, authorization denial, stream subscription, approval, cancellation, and tool calls

phases.name: Contracts and security skeleton
phases.exit_gate: OpenAPI/AsyncAPI schemas validate and unauthorized/cross-tenant tests fail closed

phases.name: Run state, idempotency, and outbox
phases.exit_gate: Duplicate create and process restart produce one run and no lost event

phases.name: Broker consumers, inbox, retry, and DLQ
phases.exit_gate: Duplicate and poison messages have deterministic outcomes

phases.name: SSE event store, replay, heartbeat, and bounded queues
phases.exit_gate: Reconnect and cursor expiry recover correctly through the real gateway

phases.name: Client state machine and snapshot recovery
phases.exit_gate: Network drop, token expiry, and slow rendering do not corrupt state

phases.name: Observability, load, chaos, and rollout
phases.exit_gate: SLOs hold at peak and canary rollback is rehearsed

observability: time to first event and event delivery latency
replay count and snapshot reset count
server/client buffer depth and slow-client disconnects
outbox age, consumer lag, retry count, and DLQ count
auth failures, forbidden subscriptions, and approval audit

decisions.selected: fetch-compatible SSE with durable replay and snapshot fallback
decisions.rationale: Most output is server-to-client text/progress; HTTP deployment and replay are simpler than a duplex socket.

decisions.selected: partitioned durable stream plus transactional outbox and inbox deduplication
decisions.rationale: Run completion, approvals, and tool side effects must survive process failure and duplicate delivery.
